title: The fanfiction community is at war with AI — and itself
slides: Who decided AI owns fanfiction's soul?
A platform just banned AI works outright.
But most 'human' writers already use AI tools.
Your next favorite story may be a lie.
Pick a side before you post again.
thread_text:
1. Who owns your story?

A platform just banned all AI-generated works outright, drawing a hard line in the sand.

2. But the line is blurry.

Most 'human' writers already rely on AI tools for grammar, structure, and plot ideas.

3. The real twist.

Your next favorite novel might be written by a model you don't even know exists.

4. Trust is the casualty.

Every new story now carries a hidden question: was this written or generated?

5. Pick a side today.

Take your next writing session and simulate ChatGPT drafting a full paragraph. Then compare your editing time to the time saved.

instagram.caption:
A major fanfiction platform just banned all AI-generated works, drawing a clear line in the sand.

But here’s the problem: many writers already lean on AI for grammar, structure, or plot ideas. The line between "human" and "machine" isn't just blurred—it’s invisible.

Now, every new story comes with a hidden question: was this created or generated? 🖋️

Trust is the casualty here 😶. For creators, it means your next favorite novel might be written by a model you never knew existed.

Next time you sit down to write ✍️, ask yourself: would I still stand by my story if I learned it was half-written by a tool I didn't disclose?
